solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Sales
solution_components.role: Applies generative AI to seller emails, meetings, and relationship context so teams can create contacts, summarize activity, and update CRM records in the flow of work.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Manages relationship and opportunity data that sales teams update through connected workflows.

solution_components.name: Outlook
solution_components.role: Hosts email workflows where users review AI-generated summaries, draft messages, and act on customer or operational communications.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Hosts collaboration, meetings, and chat workflows where users consume summaries, updates, and shared operational context.

data_flow: Emails, meeting activity, and CRM records are brought together in seller workflows; Copilot summarizes or drafts next steps in Outlook and Teams, and validated details are written back to CRM for future selling activity.
